# MrW Overlay for POE 2 v2.16.1

## What's new

- **Loot filter:** exceptional items (extra sockets or 21%+ quality) on bases that require less than level 65 are no longer priced and stay hidden. Valuable exceptional drops are endgame bases; the low ones took most of the price searches and were almost never worth picking up. To see them anyway, turn on Settings → Equipment → **Show exceptional items below level 65**.
- **Still priced:** the few low bases NeverSink rates as valuable exceptional bases or as Orb of Chance targets (Withered Wand, Siphoning Wand, Shrine Sceptre and others).
- **Faster prices:** with fewer bases to search, every exceptional price is refreshed about three times as often.

MrW Overlay is built by a player, for players. It is not an official Grinding Gear Games product, and they don't back it.

## Updating

On v1.8.0 or later, update from Settings → **Updates**. Your filter settings, profiles, saved searches and pathofexile.com connection are kept. The Microsoft Store version updates through the Store.

## Install

The release file is `poe2filtre-windows-amd64.exe`. It is not code-signed, so Windows SmartScreen may warn you: **More info → Run anyway**. Or get it from the Microsoft Store: https://apps.microsoft.com/detail/9PM376D3LFBG
